question: How great a material wealth is insufficient compared to this teaching?
premises: An ocean filled with jewels is imagined
Such accumulation is attributed to someone
inference: Even possessing an ocean full of jewels is not comparable to this teaching
uncertainties: ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is a fused and unclear form
plain_english: Even if one had an accumulation enough to make the ocean filled with jewels.
